title: Bank asks you to update KYC at the branch

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning, this is Priya from State Bank, Koramangala branch. Your KYC documents are due for periodic update.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: What do I need to do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please visit the branch with your Aadhaar and PAN any working day this month, or update it in the YONO app.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password on a call. If anyone does, please report it.
